notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for atomic regional interaction region-context validation. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich model FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, interaction and parameter names, and dimension names. It verifies that a send using a region set containing a dimension unavailable to the interaction class fails with InvalidRegionContext before delivery, that a rejected regional subscription leaves no partial declaration, and that valid regional sends and subscriptions still deliver their payload, tag, producer, transportation, and conveyed source-region metadata. It does not assert provider-specific region encodings, registries, headers, or fixture names.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador interaction dimension lookup, regional interaction publication and subscription, region creation and modification, region-qualified interaction send, and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador regional interaction region-context validation declarations
